note: Set A captures more of the sheet's real facts correctly — 14 GAUGE and 16 GAUGE plates, HSS4X4X1/4, 3" DIAM STD. PIPE, PL5x4x3/8 TYP, W6X20, #10 TEK SCREWS, the (4)3/4" DIA HOLES and the '6" MIN EACH SIDE' condition — while Set B invents bindings such as 3" and 2" 'fitted stiffener' dimensions (those numbers come from the foundation dimension string) and calls the 3/8" TYP items a weld size. Set B does get the fitted stiffener right as PL5X3/8, which Set A misassigns to PL5x4x3/8, and A also wrongly attributes the 3/4" holes to the stiffener. Both sets are padded with duplicates and vague claims (e.g. A's 'connection | 3/8"', B's 'presence | indicated'), and both attach unsupported weld conditions to the 1/4" welds, but A's errors are fewer and its coverage is broader.
